In the
Kenton Hundred , Kent Co. census, Jesse was found living with Sarah, Ernest , his father-in-law, James Seeney (age 57) and 2 brothers-in law, John (age 30) and Joseph (age 11).
In the Kent Co. Deeds (Liber U, Vol. 17) for 17 December,
recording the sale of lands once owned by Robert Dean, Jesse is shown living in Kent Co., DE.
Jesse died 12 August,
and is buried at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold., DE. The grave marker is engraved -Jesse Dean (
). Buried nearby are E.C. Dean (son Ernest Clarence ?), S. A. Dean (wife Sarah???) and Edward and Laura Carter (no dates).
His death certificate lists his age as "73" , his race as "Moor".
